newsitem.title: USA: American Business names Wellman president.
newsitem.headline: American Business names Wellman president.

text.p: American Business Information Inc said Wednesday it named Jon Wellman as president and chief operating officer and elected him as a director, effective immediately.
Wellman joined American Business Information as chief financial officer on August 1, 1995. He was appointed executive vice president of operations and finance on June 13, 1996.

The company also said it promoted Monica Messer to executive vice president and chief information officer; Elliot Katz to senior vice president of field sales organization; and John Copenhaver to vice president of catalog sales.
American Business Information provides information on businesses in the United States and Canada.
The positions of president and chief operating officer had been vacant for about a year.
